items.description: Stat!Ref is a virtual source of healthcare information in a wide variety of medicine fields. Stat!Ref invites developers to use their API to show a search bar with their information on a new site. The API is about healthcare information. To create an application, developers have access to RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 formats. The required parameters are searchTerms and grpalias. Some of the optional parameters include startIndex, count, sr:titleList and format. In the site, developers can find examples for queries and error handling. Developer support available.
